name: presenter-a
desc: A Home Counties English woman in her forties, a seasoned breakfast-TV weather presenter: bright, warm, unflappable, smiling through every word, crisp consonants, a gentle lift at the end of each sentence.

name: presenter-b
desc: A Yorkshire man in his fifties, a regional TV weatherman from Leeds: dry, steady, matter-of-fact, flat vowels, never hurried, the calm of someone who has read out a thousand cold fronts.

name: presenter-c
desc: A smooth London man in his thirties, a polished national-news weather presenter: confident, measured, faintly pleased with himself, warm low voice, every word placed carefully.

name: presenter-d
desc: A Mancunian woman in her thirties, a lively local-radio weather voice from Manchester: quick, chirpy, a little deadpan underneath, clear Northern English vowels.
